name: CitadelRedeem fixed-rate live-route quotation
summary: CitadelRedeem.redeem converted a fixed-rate stake's USD entitlement into WETH with Camelot's live getAmountsOut on the USDC.e/WETH pair. The attacker staked CIT, flash-borrowed 4,500 WETH, dumped it into the pair so each USDC quoted far more WETH, redeemed for treasury WETH and swapped back, three times.
notes: maxRedeemableFixed (slot 0x0a) was zero until this owner call, so the fixed-rate branch that prices with the live Camelot quote could not pay out before it; the CIT, staking and treasury bindings came ~13 s after deployment, and the staking startEpoch is an activation, not a HIGH field.
Loss is the treasury's gross WETH outflow over the three redemptions; the CIT the attacker staked and burned (the refs' deposit and withdrawal) is not subtracted (rule 14).
